pageDescription: The follow-ups after incidents: who owns each one, when it is due and where it stands.

tracked.title: Nothing to follow up
tracked.description: Accepted action items that are open, in progress or blocked appear here.

finished.title: Nothing finished yet
finished.description: Items marked done or won't do appear here.

suggested.title: No suggestions waiting
suggested.description: Keigan suggests action items when it drafts a postmortem. Each waits here until a person accepts or discards it.

typeHelp.mitigate: Reduces the impact or the time to recover.

title.wont_do: Close this item as won't do

plain.open: The item goes back to open and its completion is cleared.
plain.in_progress: The item moves to in progress.

statusDialog.reasonHelp: Say why, so the next person understands. It stays on the item.
statusDialog.noteHelp: A short note on how it was finished, for example a link to the change.

dialog.acceptDescription: Accepting makes this a tracked commitment. Choose the owner and check the due date.

panel.title: Action items
panel.description: Follow-ups from this postmortem. Accept the ones the team commits to; the table in the report follows them.
panel.finalDescription: Follow-ups from this postmortem. They are tracked until done.
panel.suggestedBody: Accept or discard each suggestion before you finalise the postmortem.

skipReason.no_due_date: It has no due date. Open it and choose one.
skipReason.due_date_not_allowed: Its due date is in the past or too far away. Open it and change it.

overview.periodHelp: The figures cover the period you choose. Open and overdue always count every unfinished item.

empty.title: Nothing needs attention
empty.description: No overdue items, top-priority items without an owner, open policy requirements or missing postmortems in this scope.

breachKind.single_incident: One incident used a large share
breachKind.outage_class: One kind of outage used a large share

kindHelp.overdue_item: Items past their due date, the most urgent first.
kindHelp.top_priority_unowned: Items marked top priority that nobody owns yet.
kindHelp.policy_breach_open: An error budget policy asks for a postmortem or a top-priority prevent item that is not there yet.
kindHelp.postmortem_missing: Serious incidents that were resolved but have no final postmortem.
kindHelp.proposed_waiting: Items Keigan suggested that nobody has accepted or discarded.

empty.title: No repeated incidents
empty.description: When an incident of the same kind comes back on the same service inside the look-back window, the series appears here.

outcome.no_postmortem: Came back; no postmortem had been finished before it
outcome.no_prevent_item: Came back; no follow-up was tracked to prevent it
outcome.repeated_while_open_one: Came back while {{count}} follow-up was still open
outcome.repeated_while_open_other: Came back while {{count}} follow-ups were still open
outcome.repeated_after_done: Came back after every follow-up was done: the fix may not have worked

errors.actionFailed: That change could not be saved.
